label: Meeting room, Jabra (GN Audio) offices, Ballerup
note: furnished, lightly damped meeting room; average T60 0.55 s (README.md); one loudspeaker (KEF LS50) in the middle of the room; 130 microphone positions chosen at random in a 2.6 x 2.3 m area at one end of the room (grid-N) and 6 in the loudspeaker's near field (ref-N), all at the loudspeaker's height; positions from a Vicon motion-capture system, in metres with the loudspeaker at the origin (HDF5 file); each IR starts with about 0.1 s before the direct sound. RIRDB's 500 Hz-1 kHz T30 is 0.47 s. The README's average T60 of 0.55 s matches the mean T30 from 125 Hz to 4 kHz (0.56 s), since T30 rises to 0.57-0.65 s at 2-4 kHz. The 6 near-field reference IRs (ref-N, 9 cm from the loudspeaker) read 0.38 s because the direct sound dominates their decay.
